subject: Wall Street Highs And AI Bubble Risks
body_text:

Here's the latest in trending:Huge uprate: Constellation (CEG)-Google (GOOGL) deal sparks power stock rally.More debt: SpaceX (SPCX) eyes borrowing $40B to buy Nvidia (NVDA) chips.Stark warning: Chevron (CVX) CEO flags thinning oil and fuel supply buffers.

 Good morning! Here's the latest in trending: 

 Huge uprate:  Constellation ( CEG )-Google ( GOOGL ) deal sparks power stock rally .

 More debt:  SpaceX ( SPCX ) eyes borrowing $40B  to buy Nvidia ( NVDA ) chips.

 Stark warning: Chevron ( CVX ) CEO flags thinning oil and  fuel supply buffers .
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Top News
 
 
 
 New records 
 
 
 
Getty Images
 
 
The AI trade propelled the stock market to fresh highs this week, with the S&P 500 ( SP500 ) and Nasdaq ( COMP:IND ) notching record closes on Tuesday. However, these gains have largely been limited to stocks benefiting from the AI boom and the rally defies warning signs in the bond market.

 Concentration risk:  The S&P 500 topped 7,800 for the first time  on Tuesday, fueled by the AI trade. But less than half of the stocks in the S&P 500 closed higher than their 200-day moving average on Tuesday, according to Dow Jones Market Data. Higher interest rates and inflation are weighing on other stocks in the S&P 500. "It's only the fortress-like balance sheets at the large-cap end of the spectrum that are propping the market up,"  Dan Russo, investment chief at Potomac Fund Management, told The Wall Street Journal . Seeking Alpha analyst Andrew Hecht also pointed to rising rates and rising stocks defying the historical status quo . "The question becomes: is a volatile storm on the horizon, or are markets settling into a new paradigm in late 2026? Time will tell," Hecht added.

 Breaking point: While AI enthusiasm is raging on, billionaire investor Ray Dalio once again sounded the alarm on bubble risks. On Wednesday, the Bridgewater Associates founder warned that the AI bubble is nearing the point where it may burst due to rising interest rates and increased borrowing to fund the AI infrastructure buildout.  "We're in the part of the cycle that is before that, but approaching that," Dalio said. "I think we're close to that ." Just a day earlier, he talked about how heavy borrowing to buy assets, or a potential wealth tax that requires selling assets to make money, can lead to a bubble bursting. "What creates the bursting of a bubble is the fact that you need cash," Dalio said. "And you start to convert the wealth that you have to do that. Something like a wealth tax would have that effect, or having to pay back loans. So there's that dynamic that we have to keep an eye on."

 SA commentary: According to Investing Group Leader Bret Jensen, market breadth is historically poor. "Tech titans have driven Nasdaq and S&P 500 gains while the majority of stocks lag, echoing dot-com bubble dynamics ," he noted. Despite concerns of higher-for-longer rates and geopolitical conflicts, tech stocks likely have more room to run as markets expect another strong earnings season, which starts next week. "The hyperscalers have proven that they can successfully convert capex into higher earnings growth while also funding this growth through free cash flow instead of becoming too reliant on debt ," SA analyst Cain Lee said. And as the AI infrastructure buildout remains strong, Lee said companies are going to borrow regardless of what interest rates look like. "The only variable is how the market reacts to that based on how much interest expenses can weigh on earnings."
